english.title: Motor vehicle - fail to prevent movement of a trailer at rest on a road

additionalkeywords.additionalkeyword: Road Vehicles Construction and Use Regulations 1986

english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..), being the person in charge of a motor vehicle, namely **(..SPECIFY VEHICLE MAKE AND INDEX NUMBER..), drawing a trailer caused that trailer to stand on a road, namely **(..SPECIFY ROAD AND LOCATION..), when detached from the drawing vehicle and failed to ensure that

(A)_[at least one of the wheels of that trailer]_
(B)_[the tracks of a track laying trailer]_

were prevented from revolving by the setting of a parking brake, the use of a chain, chock or other efficient device, namely **(..SPECIFY THE DEVICE EMPLOYED..)
english.legislation: Contrary to regulation 89 of the Road Vehicles (Construction and Use) Regulations 1986, section 42 of the Road Traffic Act 1988 and Schedule 2 to the Road Traffic Offenders Act 1988.
english.pointstoprove:
date and location

other.penalty:
A fine not exceeding level four on the standard scale if in respect of goods vehicle or vehicle adapted to carry more than eight passengers.

A fine not exceeding level three on the standard scale in any other case.

Fixed penalty ticket - fifty pounds.

Time limit for prosecution
6 months
